```python
from z3 import *

# Declare boolean variables representing the C conditions/variables.
# In C, pointers/values used in boolean context are treated as "non-null / non-zero".
# We model each as a Bool where True means "non-null / non-zero / success".

newreq = Bool('newreq')
gen_x509 = Bool('gen_x509')
precert = Bool('precert')
addext_conf = Bool('addext_conf')          # addext_conf != NULL
extsect = Bool('extsect')                  # extsect != NULL
CAcert = Bool('CAcert')                    # CAcert != NULL
pub_key = Bool('pub_key')                  # pub_key != NULL
serial = Bool('serial')                    # serial != NULL
i = Bool('i')                              # !i  -> i is zero/false
outformat_is_asn1 = Bool('outformat_is_asn1')  # outformat == FORMAT_ASN1

# new_x509 is the variable of interest. We model it as a Bool:
#   True  -> new_x509 != NULL (allocation succeeded)
#   False -> new_x509 == NULL
new_x509 = Bool('new_x509')

# Helper: the guard "!(newreq || gen_x509) || !(gen_x509)" simplifies to
#   !(newreq || gen_x509) || !gen_x509
# which is equivalent to !gen_x509 (since if gen_x509 is true, the second
# disjunct is false and the first requires !newreq; but the original C
# semantics is: the block runs only when (newreq || gen_x509) && gen_x509,
# i.e. gen_x509 is true). We keep the literal form for fidelity.
def guard():
    return Or(Not(Or(newreq, gen_x509)), Not(gen_x509))

s = Solver()

# Constraint 1: allocation check
#   !(newreq || gen_x509) || !(gen_x509) || !((new_x509 = X509_new_ex(...)) == NULL)
# The assignment succeeds iff new_x509 != NULL, i.e. new_x509 is True.
s.add(Or(guard(), new_x509))

# Constraint 2: precert poison extension
#   !(newreq || gen_x509) || !(gen_x509) || !(precert) || !(X509_add1_ext_i2d(...) != 1)
# The call succeeds (returns 1) -> the negated condition is false.
# We model "call succeeded" as a fresh Bool; here we only need that when
# precert is true, the call must succeed, so the constraint is:
#   guard || !precert || call_ok
call_ok_poison = Bool('call_ok_poison')
s.add(Or(guard(), Not(precert), call_ok_poison))

# Constraint 3: addext_conf extension
#   !(newreq || gen_x509) || !(gen_x509) || !(addext_conf != NULL && !X509V3_EXT_add_nconf(...))
# The inner condition is (addext_conf != NULL) && (call returns 0).
# Negated: !(addext_conf && call_ok) = !addext_conf || !call_ok
call_ok_addext = Bool('call_ok_addext')
s.add(Or(guard(), Not(addext_conf), Not(call_ok_addext)))

# Constraint 4: extsect extension
#   !(newreq || gen_x509) || !(gen_x509) || !(extsect != NULL && !X509V3_EXT_add_nconf(...))
call_ok_extsect = Bool('call_ok_extsect')
s.add(Or(guard(), Not(extsect), Not(call_ok_extsect)))

# Constraint 5: issuer pkey
#   !(newreq || gen_x509) || !(gen_x509) || !(CAcert == NULL) || !(!X509V3_set_issuer_pkey(...))
# CAcert == NULL  ->  !CAcert
# !X509V3_set_issuer_pkey(...) is true when the call fails; the constraint
# requires the call to succeed when CAcert != NULL.
call_ok_issuer = Bool('call_ok_issuer')
s.add(Or(guard(), CAcert, call_ok_issuer))

# Constraint 6: copy_extensions
#   !(newreq || gen_x509) || !(gen_x509) || !(!copy_extensions(...))
# Requires copy_extensions to succeed.
call_ok_copy = Bool('call_ok_copy')
s.add(Or(guard(), call_ok_copy))

# Constraint 7: set pubkey
#   !(newreq || gen_x509) || !(gen_x509) || !(!pub_key || !X509_set_pubkey(...))
# If pub_key != NULL, X509_set_pubkey must succeed.
call_ok_pubkey = Bool('call_ok_pubkey')
s.add(Or(guard(), Not(pub_key), call_ok_pubkey))

# Constraint 8: set subject name
call_ok_subj = Bool('call_ok_subj')
s.add(Or(guard(), call_ok_subj))

# Constraint 9: set cert times
call_ok_times = Bool('call_ok_times')
s.add(Or(guard(), call_ok_times))

# Constraint 10: set issuer name
call_ok_issuer_name = Bool('call_ok_issuer_name')
s.add(Or(guard(), call_ok_issuer_name))

# Constraint 11: serial handling (rand_serial branch)
#   !(newreq || gen_x509) || !(gen_x509) || !(!(serial != NULL)) || !(!rand_serial(...))
# !(serial != NULL)  ->  !serial
# !rand_serial(...)  ->  rand_serial failed; constraint requires success.
call_ok_rand_serial = Bool('call_ok_rand_serial')
s.add(Or(guard(), Not(serial), call_ok_rand_serial))

# Constraint 12: serial handling (explicit serial branch)
#   !(newreq || gen_x509) || !(gen_x509) || !(serial != NULL) || !(!X509_set_serialNumber(...))
# If serial != NULL, X509_set_serialNumber must succeed.
call_ok_set_serial = Bool('call_ok_set_serial')
s.add(Or(guard(), Not(serial), call_ok_set_serial))

# Constraint 13: !i
#   !(newreq || gen_x509) || !(gen_x509) || !(!i)
# !(!i) = i, so this requires i to be false when the block runs.
s.add(Or(guard(), Not(i)))

# Constraint 14: new_x509 != NULL (redundant with constraint 1 but kept)
s.add(Or(guard(), new_x509))

# Constraint 15: ASN1 output format branch
#   !(newreq || gen_x509) || !(gen_x509) || !(gen_x509) || !(outformat == FORMAT_ASN1) || !(!i)
# Requires: if outformat == FORMAT_ASN1, then i must be false.
s.add(Or(guard(), Not(outformat_is_asn1), Not(i)))

# Constraint 16: duplicate of 15 (kept for fidelity)
s.add(Or(guard(), Not(outformat_is_asn1), Not(i)))

# Check satisfiability and print a model
if s.check() == sat:
    print("SAT")
    print(s.model())
else:
    print("UNSAT")
```
